subject: Expose archived_tasks slim list on GET /state
description: Repurpose Force Cloud archive bundle to show real server-archived tasks (stale done/canceled + old superseded notes per frontier.archivedIds). Step 1: extend routes/meta.js /state so summary.archived count is paired with archived_tasks — slim nodes { id, label, status, kind, lastChanged } for IDs in the archive set. Reuse frontier.archivedIds() + frontier.frontierKeep(); do not duplicate logic client-side. Keep default payload lean: either always attach slim archived_tasks when arch.size > 0, or gate behind ?archived_tasks=1 — pick whichever matches existing /state patterns. Add/adjust test in test/frontier.test.js or test/endpoints.test.js.
